headline: ARC Prize reports Gemini 4 Argon Verified results

sections.text: ARC Prize says Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5% on ARC-AGI-3 with its provider adapter, at $4.8K, and 49.8% with the standard harness, at $5.8K.
The post also reports 91.3% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.32 per task and 98.5% on ARC-AGI-1 at $0.16 per task.
